mod.name: Journey Mode
mod.description: A story mode with a walkable 3D world: character creation, 30 people in 16 areas over eight chapters, the game's own text boxes and duels with a deck for each duelist, area music, a START menu, a save file and two endings. Characters: Quaternius (CC0); props: PSX Nature Free by heyheythere (CC BY 4.0).

hint.controls: Arrows: walk   Circle: run   X: talk   Start: menu

bag.title: Backpack
bag.subtitle: What the journey gave you: items and cards from the story.

courier_met.desc: A courier's card with a row of stamps. It proves you are on the town's errand list.
courier_met.from: The courier, the day you met him.

farmer_won.desc: An oil lantern that lights the dark corners of the old roads.
farmer_won.from: Kemet the farmer, after you beat him in a duel.

jug_taken.desc: An empty clay jug, waiting to be filled.
jug_taken.from: Taken for Teana's errand; fill it at the river.

got_honey.desc: A small pot of golden honey for the festival cakes.

got_water.desc: The jug, now full of cool river water.

got_dates.desc: A bunch of sweet, ripe dates.

treasure_lost.desc: An old golden scarab said to belong to the town's founder.
treasure_lost.from: Found during the search for the lost treasure.

treasure_won.desc: Jono's red bandana, a token of a hard-won duel.
treasure_won.from: Jono, after the duel for the treasure.

treasure_given.desc: A little charm for luck, given in thanks.
treasure_given.from: Teana, in thanks for the ingredients.

inseto_won.desc: InsetoKaiba's tiny gold beetle pin. Pure vanity.

weevil_won.desc: Weevil's dice. Every face is a six.

forest_mage_won.desc: A leaf that rustles when a star is near.

carver_found.desc: Croquet's chisel. The tip still glows like a star.

teana_meadow_won.desc: Teana's charm. She tips you through the maze and beyond.

isis_desert_won.desc: Isis's charm. Someone upstairs harvests lost stars.
isis_desert_won.from: Isis, in the Desert of Lost Stars.

jono_fair_won.desc: Jono's charm. He tips you around the fair.

inseto_gate_won.desc: InsetoKaiba's key. The star-lock counts ten.

star_chips.desc: A lost bet stays with the rival. Ten open the castle. ZERO STARS = GAME OVER.
star_chips.from: Shadi's Star Passage, then the duelists who guard each zone.

wager.title: Star Wager
wager.subtitle: Choose how many stars to bet

wager.warn: If your stars run out, your journey ends. GAME OVER.
wager.allin: All-in! Losing this duel is GAME OVER.
wager.go_line1: Your last Star Chip is gone.
wager.go_line2: The Kingdom's gates close behind you.
